# Knot

> High-performance codebase indexer for AI agents. Extracts structural and semantic
> information from source code using vector search (Qdrant) and a graph database (Neo4j).
> Answers each exploration question with a targeted result instead of whole source files:
> measured 81.7% fewer tokens (5.5×) than grep + reading the code.

## Products

- [Knot CLI](https://github.com/raultov/knot): indexer, MCP server and CLI client.
- [Knot Server](https://github.com/raultov/knot-server): distributed REST API, webhooks, scheduler,
  graph viewer and Swagger UI.

## Token Efficiency (measured)

LLM token cost of answering each question through Knot versus grepping and reading
the source, counted with OpenAI cl100k_base on the exact tool output received.

| Task | Repo | Lang | Knot tokens | Read the code | Saved |
|------|------|------|------------:|--------------:|------:|
| discovery | spring-ai | Java | 1092 | 10168 | 89.3% |
| callers | spring-ai | Java | 8808 | 15554 | 43.4% |
| explore | spring-ai | Java | 4865 | 7838 | 37.9% |
| discovery | puppeteer | TypeScript | 609 | 4149 | 85.3% |
| callers | puppeteer | TypeScript | 1004 | 39878 | 97.5% |
| explore | puppeteer | TypeScript | 7287 | 25300 | 71.2% |
| discovery | knot | Rust | 594 | 14824 | 96% |
| callers | knot | Rust | 461 | 10949 | 95.8% |
| explore | knot | Rust | 978 | 12103 | 91.9% |
| **TOTAL** | — | 9 tasks | **25698** | **140763** | **81.7%** |

5.5× fewer tokens for the same 9 questions — 115,065 tokens saved.

## Capabilities

- **Semantic + Structural Search** — Find code by meaning, class names, docstrings, or architectural patterns. Powered by Qdrant vector embeddings and Neo4j graph traversal.
- **Multi-Language Support** — Java, Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Rust, Groovy, C/C++, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Markdown, Varnish Cache (VCL), plus build system files (Maven, Gradle, Jenkins, Cargo, MSBuild/NuGet). Full cross-language linking plus hierarchical full-body search across Markdown documentation.
- **Incremental Indexing** — SHA-256 file hashing skips unchanged files. Real-time watch mode re-indexes in seconds. Tune CPU and memory via environment variables to fit any machine.
- **MCP + CLI** — Model Context Protocol server for AI agents (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Cursor). Standalone CLI for scripts and CI/CD pipelines.
- **Dual-Database Architecture** — Vector search (Qdrant) for semantic understanding, graph database (Neo4j) for architectural relationships and call chains.
- **Cross-Repo Dependency Resolution** — Auto-discovers dependencies between indexed repositories. Transitive call chain resolution across project boundaries.
- **Measured Token Efficiency** — 81.7% fewer tokens than grepping and reading the code — 5.5× cheaper across nine real exploration tasks on three indexed repositories. Measured with tiktoken on the exact tool output an LLM receives, not claimed.

## Knot Server

- **REST API** — Register repos, trigger indexing, and query search/callers/explore endpoints via a clean JSON REST API. Interactive Swagger UI at /docs and OpenAPI spec for codegen.
- **Git Webhooks** — GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket webhooks with HMAC-SHA256 signature validation trigger instant incremental re-indexing on every push.
- **Background Scheduler** — Automatic stale lock cleanup and periodic re-indexing. Tunable via POLL_INTERVAL_SECS, MAX_INDEX_AGE_SECS, and STALE_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECS in docker-compose.
- **Cluster & HA** — Horizontal scale-out with file-based distributed locking. Deploy multiple instances sharing an NFS/EFS workspace or a Kubernetes RWX PVC.
- **Container-Native & K8s Ready** — Official raultov/knot-server image on Docker Hub. Tune CPU and memory via environment variables to match any pod resource limit — from a lightweight 2-core sidecar to a full-cluster deployment.
- **Interactive Graph Viewer** — Explore your indexed codebase visually at /graph. Filter by entity kind, toggle relationship types, focus at any depth, color-coded by language and kind.
- **Agent Skills & /index** — 9 per-topic skills auto-install for Claude Desktop, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot. The /index slash command registers and indexes the current repo end-to-end from your editor.
- **Local & Remote Repos** — Index Git URLs or local working trees. Idempotent re-registration via POST /api/repos. Build outputs (target/, node_modules/, .gradle/, dist/) auto-excluded.
- **Metrics & Distributed Tracing** — Prometheus /metrics endpoint exposes HTTP, indexing pipeline, queue, and process metrics — Grafana-ready. Opt-in OpenTelemetry tracing exports spans via OTLP gRPC with W3C traceparent propagation.

## Supported languages

Java, Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Rust, Python, Groovy, C, C++, HTML, CSS, SCSS, Markdown, Varnish Cache (VCL)

## Installation (Knot CLI)

### 1. Install
One command installs knot-indexer, knot-mcp, and knot (CLI).
- `Install binaries`
### 2. Prerequisites
Knot needs Qdrant (vector search) and Neo4j (graph) running. The easiest way:
- `Start Qdrant & Neo4j`
### 3. Index a codebase
Point knot-indexer at any repo. Tune CPU and memory with environment variables to fit any machine.
- `Basic usage`
- `Tune resource usage (~2 cores / ~1 GB RAM)`
### 4. Query your code
Two ways to search your indexed codebase — pick the one that fits your workflow:
- `Run knot-mcp`
- `MCP config example (claude_desktop_config.json)`
- `Install agent skills`
- `Search, trace callers, explore files`

## Installation (Knot Server)

### 1. Install
Three ways to get knot-server. Option C bundles the databases — skip straight to Run.
- `Install via curl`
- `Pull from Docker Hub`
- `Download docker-compose.yml`
### 2. Prerequisites
Only needed for Options A and B. Knot Server requires Qdrant (vector search) and Neo4j (graph) running. If you chose Option C, skip this step.
- `Start Qdrant & Neo4j`
### 3. Run
Pick the method that matches your install option:
- `Start the full stack`
- `Run knot-server`
- `docker run with resource tuning`
### 4. REST API
All operations are exposed through a JSON REST API on port 3000.
- `Register a Git repository`
- `Webhook endpoint`
- `Search, callers, explore, deps`
- `Health check`
### 5. Explore visually & via API
Two zero-config UIs ship with knot-server. Open them in your browser once it’s running:
- `Open in browser`
- `Open in browser`
### 6. Index from your editor
Two shortcuts to register and index the repo you are working on — without leaving your editor or terminal.
- `Run from OpenCode`
- `curl | bash`
- `9 skills included`
### 7. Monitor in production
Production-grade observability ships with knot-server: Prometheus metrics out of the box and opt-in OpenTelemetry distributed tracing.
- `Prometheus scrape config`
- `Enable tracing`
